items.title: Walmart (WMT) Begins First In Store Automated Fulfillment Pilot
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT) is piloting Symbotic's SymMicro automated fulfillment system inside one of its stores for the first time. The in store SymMicro pilot is designed to handle e commerce order fulfillment within Walmart's existing store network. The move is intended to change how Walmart processes online orders, with a focus on speed and efficiency for shoppers. This marks a new step in Walmart's use of automation technology across its retail operations. Consider looking at other stocks...

items.title: Sam Walton Gave His Kids 80% of Walmart in 1953, When It Was Worth Almost Nothing. That Single Early Move Is Why the Waltons Have Never Faced a Major Estate-Tax Bill on $250 Billion
items.summary: Sam Walton made one early financial move with his family business that the IRS still allows today, and it quietly kept hundreds of billions of dollars out of reach of federal estate taxes for generations. Most families with appreciating assets never realize the same window is open to them right now.

items.title: Why Is Tether Looking Like a Central Bank?
items.summary: Gold  recent rally is mostly due to five big buyers: four central banks and Tether, a company that deals in cryptocurrency.  Tether is buying for the very reasons that central banks are—to diversify its holdings and hedge against inflation and significant dollar weakness, which Tether’s crypto stablecoin  USDT  is pegged to.  In the first half, Tether bought more than 27 metric tons of gold—matching Kazakhstan.
